rng_seed_policy.summary: All seeds are deterministically derived per-index by derive_seed() (blake2b-8 over labeled, type-tagged parts) in experiments/src/common.py, called with fixed domain labels and the frozen offset 20281001 — e.g. derive_seed('pilot_v3_gen'|'pilot_v3_neg'|'pilot_v3_key_<kind>', 20281001, idx) in pilot_v3/scripts/run_family.py and gen_negatives.py, with RivaGAN 32-bit payloads from np.random.default_rng(20281001+idx) — so every image, key, and negative index maps to a frozen, replayable seed.
